verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents a public REST API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth. It offers 12 retrieval endpoints, batch PATCH updates, pagination and field selection, custom-field management with async job polling, user listing, receipts, and webhooks. A probe confirms the developer portal and llms.txt are live, and a hosted MCP server complements the API for AI clients. missing for 10: API coverage of the travel/booking surface (documented endpoints are expense-centric), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as described.
